high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals walking together on a gravel path in what appears to be a rural or countryside setting. The person on the left is dressed in a brown coat and dark boots, holding an umbrella in their right hand. The person on the right is wearing a white clerical robe with black trim and a red sash, indicating they are a clergy member, specifically a canon. They are also wearing a black tie and appear to be smiling. The background features a wooden gate and a grassy area with some trees and bushes.
